subject: Pilot fund re-route: apply promotional pool to dedicated trial
messages:
From: Maya Sharma <maya@olivelabs.co>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot fund re-route: apply promotional pool to dedicated trial

Hi Sofia,

Quick note — we ran into a gate on the sandbox: our security team needs isolation (VPC/dedicated) to run a realistic end-to-end scale test next month. We have a $25k promotional pool tied to the LaunchBridge cohort that currently applies only to hosted API usage. Would Redwood consider a one-time re-route of that promotional pool to cover a short dedicated trial?

High level:
- Goal: run a 2-week dedicated+private trial (dedicated GPUs, VPC) to validate infra and perf with sensitive data
- Promo pool: $25,000 in startup credits (LaunchBridge cohort)
- Ask: convert/use up to $18k of that pool for the dedicated trial, with the remainder left for hosted usage

If there's a paperwork or bookkeeping step we can do on our side (billing memo, signed addendum), we're happy to move quickly — timeline is tight. Appreciate any flexibility or precedent you can share.

Thanks,
Maya Sharma
Co-founder | Olive Labs
maya@olivelabs.co
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: promo-allocation-summary.csv (csv)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Sharma <maya@olivelabs.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot fund re-route: apply promotional pool to dedicated trial

Hi Maya — thanks for the context and the CSV. Looping in Ben (sales lead) and Irene (billing) so we can assess policy and the bookkeeping side. A couple quick clarifying Qs so we can scope the ask:

1) Is the dedicated trial being run under the same account/org as the hosted usage today (same billing entity)?
2) Do you expect the dedicated trial to exceed 1M tokens/day at peak, or is it primarily short-burst benchmarking?
3) Any contractual constraints from LaunchBridge on how credits must be used?

Ben/Irene — can you flag anything from the pricing or accounting side that would block a reallocation? If it's possible, I'd like to approve a one-time operational re-route (subject to signed addendum + billing memo) rather than a promo re-issuance.

Talk soon,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Growth Manager, Startups | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Maya Sharma <maya@olivelabs.co>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot fund re-route: apply promotional pool to dedicated trial

Thanks for the ping, Sofia — and Maya, appreciate the concise ask. We have two pragmatic paths here (operational + accounting):

Option A — One-time reallocation (recommended for speed)
- Convert up to $18k of the promo pool to a dedicated-trial credit line that can be consumed on the Dedicated product for a fixed 14-day window
- No change to the underlying promo grant; we issue a billing memo noting the re-route for audit
- Requires a short addendum to the promo terms (sign-off by Olive)
- Impact: reduces hosted promo balance to $7k

Option B — Convert to a reserved/dedicated commitment (longer-term)
- Apply promo as a partial prepayment toward a small reserved commit (3 months) with proration and a modest discount differential
- Requires procurement approval and standard reserved-contract paperwork (slower)

Proposed financial concession for Option A (to account for higher infra delta):
- Convert $18k promo to dedicated-trial credit + provide 10% token bonus (equivalent of $1.8k) as an onboarding incentive
- Redwood covers the bonus from promotional budget; Olive is responsible for any overage beyond $18k + bonus

Next steps:
1) If Olive signs the addendum + billing memo, we can operationalize the re-route within 48 hours.
2) I'll drop a DocuSign link for the addendum and loop Finance for the memo.

Maya — any red flags from your side on the 14-day window or the $18k cap?

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Startups, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Dec 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot fund re-route: apply promotional pool to dedicated trial

Hi Maya — quick update and confirmation:

We've approved a one-time operational re-route (Option A) as discussed. Summary of the agreement: 
- $18,000 of the LaunchBridge promotional pool will be reallocated to a Dedicated-trial credit usable for a 14-calendar-day dedicated instance (VPC + reserved GPU pool).
- Olive Labs retains $7,000 in the hosted promo pool after the conversion.
- Redwood will provide a 10% onboarding token bonus (value = $1,800) applied at trial start.
- Olive is responsible for any consumption above the $19,800 effective credit.

Required paperwork & timeline:
1) We will send a short MSA addendum and a billing memo for audit. Please sign the DocuSign for the addendum within 48 hours so we can provision the trial. DocuSign: https://docusign.com/placeholder/OLIVE-ADDENDUM
2) Finance will issue the billing memo once signed. Provisioning will follow within 48 hours of the memo being accepted.
3) If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute onboarding with our Dedicated ops engineer during the trial window.

Attachments: MSA-addendum-dedicated-promo.pdf (pdf), billing-memo-OLIVE-20271204.docx (docx)

If that all looks good, reply with a signed DocuSign or a quick confirmation and we'll kick off procurement on our end. Happy to jump on a call if you want to walk through the addendum.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Growth Manager, Startups | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai
